instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. In a sunny outdoor park with a suspension bridge in the background, the woman with reddish-orange hair (R2) wearing a black off-the-shoulder crop top and grey pants dances in side profile, smiling happily. Behind her on the left, the man in the striped shirt (R4) stands on the grass, watching her dance with a smile. A cropped hand of an unseen bystander is visible on the far right. Bright natural daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the warm tones of the afternoon.
